text:
Bhai, system mein status "Delivered" dikha raha hai aur courier partner "Delhivery" hai. 

Main samajh sakta hoon ki aap poora din ghar par the aur kisi ne doorbell bhi nahi bajayi. Ho sakta hai courier executive ne galat address par deliver kar diya ho ya kisi aur ko de diya ho.

Kya aap chahte hain ki main iska **refund initiate** kar doon? Uske liye mujhe pehle order details verify karni hongi.
